label: The chosen style (22 November 2026): Henry Daubrez painterly LoRA, a close half-length view cut at the belt, for cutting out
style: DB4RZ style painting. A stylised painted character for a rugged sci-fi frontier colony game, painterly game art. An ordinary, imperfect, distinctive face with its own character, plain and unidealised, bare skin.
frame: A medium close-up, cut off by the bottom edge of the picture at the belt: only the head, shoulders, chest and arms are in the picture, large and close, the head near the top and about a third of the picture's height. One person alone, bare-headed with the hair in full view. Behind them one flat, even, dark blue-grey colour fills the whole picture from edge to edge.
style_end: Painterly game art throughout, loose stylised brushwork.
